name: phase1-7-prefix-probe-diagnostic
notes: Phase 1.7 EXPLORATORY prefix-probe diagnostic (post-outcome). Reuses the already-measured test/1729 population under the frozen population lock; it is NOT a fresh confirmatory population. Runs one greedy trajectory per task per deployment and forces finalization from fixed reasoning checkpoints (256/512/1024/1536 tokens, bounded by the actual reasoning length) using the model's validated native closing sequence. Forced finalization is an ORACLE-STYLE intervention: a correct forced answer does not establish natural closure, natural accuracy, or a deployable stopping policy. No model execution without explicit authorization.
